## What's changed

- Added self-contained FSRCNNX AI upscaling to the macOS app by bundling MoltenVK, allowing Apple Silicon to run the Vulkan shader through Metal without a separate Homebrew installation.
- Added a release-time FSRCNNX compatibility test so incomplete macOS AI-upscaling packages fail during the build instead of falling back unexpectedly after installation.
- Added clear live upscaling indicators throughout Active Streams, Tater Tube Players, and Playback Activity, including the actual FSRCNNX, Spline36, or portable Spline method in use.
- Made AI fallback visible when the requested AI upscaler is unavailable and Standard upscaling is used instead.
- Preserved upscaling details in playback history and player-presence records.

These are server-side updates; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
